description: Changes which board a connected Pinterest account pins to when a post names none. The board is checked against the account’s boards on Pinterest first. Ask the user before changing it. Answers the account, whose name now ends in the board’s name.

accountId.description: A Pinterest account id from accounts_list.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

name: accounts_board
title: Choose a Pinterest board
